# Purpose

This report compares the outputs of `FADN2Footprint` (v`r packageVersion("FADN2Footprint")`)
against the raw FADN data.
An estimate is flagged **in range** if it falls within the literature min–max,
**within tolerance** if the relative deviation from the literature midpoint is
below a per-indicator threshold, or **out of range** otherwise.

# Load raw FADN data


# Crop areas

## Comparison of sum of individual crop areas to total area variable

First, I want to check if I can recalculate the total utilised agricultural area variable (SE025) from the sum of crop areas with raw data.

```{r raw_crop_areas_sum}
# Extraction & Pivoting
# Filter, Pivot Long, and Split Code/Variable in one pass using tidyr::extract
raw_areas_crop <- raw_fadn |>
  dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID), YEAR = as.character(YEAR)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    ID,
    COUNTRY,
    YEAR,
    SYS02,
    # keep only area (TA) variables
    #                  dplyr::matches("^C") & dplyr::matches("_TA$"),
    # keep only area (A) variables
    dplyr::matches("^C") & dplyr::matches("_A$|_TA$"),
    -dplyr::matches("^CTOT")
  ) |>
  # Pivot longer to handle all herd variables at once
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c("ID", "COUNTRY", "YEAR", "SYS02"),
    names_to = "raw_variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  # keep only variable with observed values
  dplyr::filter(value > 0) |>
  # Remove the "_TA" suffix from the raw variable names
  dplyr::mutate(
    FADN_code_letter = sub("_TA$|_A$", "", raw_variable),
    area_var = stringr::str_extract(raw_variable, "TA$|A$")
  ) |>
  # pivot variables
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("ID", "COUNTRY", "YEAR", "SYS02", "FADN_code_letter"),
    names_from = area_var,
    values_from = value
  ) |>
  # estimate max area
  dplyr::mutate(
    area_ha = pmax(A, TA, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


raw_areas_crop$FADN_code_letter |> unique() |> sort()
```

- 10300 Potatoes (including early potatoes and seed potatoes) Includes early and seed potatoes (i.e. propagation material).
- 10310 - of which potatoes for starch To be entered if details are available in the holding’s accounts.
- 10390 - of which other potatoes
- 40101 Pome fruits Pome fruits such as apples, pears, quinces or medlars.
- 40111 - of which apples Due to a limited number of subcategories, the sum of subcategories’ values might be less than the values in the main category.
- 40112 - of which pears
- 40102 Stone fruits Stone fruits, such as peaches and nectarines, apricots, sweet and sour cherries, plums and other stone fruits not elsewhere classified.
- 40113 - of which peaches and nectarines
- 40200 Citrus fruits
- 40210 - of which oranges
- 40230 - of which lemons
- 40600 Other permanent crops Includes osier willow, bamboo, rush, rattan, carob-tree, tea, coffee and truffles. Excludes asparagus (to be entered under ► Category 10790 – Other vegetables').
- 40610 - of which Christmas trees
- 50200 Wooded area
- 50210 - of which short rotation coppices

```{r comp_raw_areas_crop_sum_SE025}

crops_of_which <- data_extra$crops |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(
    "10310|10390|40111|40112|40113|40210|40230|40610|50210",
    FADN_code_number
  )) |>
  dplyr::pull(FADN_code_letter)

# « Sub-Categories of 'Fresh vegetables, melons and strawberries' and 'Flowers and ornamental plants (excluding nurseries):
# • For ► sub-categories 10731 – 10790 and 10830 – 10850, the total cropped areas of each of the successive crops are recorded;
# • The Utilised Agricultural Area (UAA) is entered under the parent ► Categories 10711, 10712, 10720 and 10810 and 10820;
# • Where successive crops are cultivated, the sum of the areas of ►subcategories 10731 – 10790 and 10830 – 10850 will be equal or greater than the sum of the UAA of the parent ► Categories 10711, 10712, 10720 and 10810 and 10820. »
# (“Farm Return Data Definitions - From accounting year 2023”, 2024, p. 70)
crops_sub_cat <- data_extra$crops |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(
    paste(c(seq(10731, 10790, 1), seq(10830, 10850, 1)), collapse = "|"),
    FADN_code_number
  )) |>
  dplyr::pull(FADN_code_letter)

raw_areas_crop_sum <- raw_areas_crop |>
  dplyr::filter(
    # remove mushroom, unused land, other land and rented out land
    !grepl("CMUSH|CUNUSEDLND|CLNDOTH|CRENTOUTLND", FADN_code_letter),
    # crops of which and sub-categories are removed
    !FADN_code_letter %in% crops_of_which,
    !FADN_code_letter %in% crops_sub_cat
  ) |>
  # remove aberrant bulgarian farm
  dplyr::filter(ID != "92300000037351") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    crop_area_sum = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(COUNTRY, YEAR, ID)
  )

raw_areas_SE025 <- raw_fadn |>
  dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID), YEAR = as.character(YEAR)) |>
  dplyr::select(ID, COUNTRY, YEAR, SYS02, SE025) |>
  dplyr::filter(SE025 > 0)

# plot
comp_raw_crop_sum_SE025 <- raw_areas_SE025 |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    raw_areas_crop_sum,
    by = c("COUNTRY", "YEAR", "ID")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rel_diff = (SE025 - dplyr::coalesce(crop_area_sum, 0)) / SE025)
#comp_raw_crop_sum_SE025 |> reactable::reactable(searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)

#hist(comp_raw_crop_sum_SE025$rel_diff)

comp_raw_crop_sum_SE025 |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = SE025, y = crop_area_sum) +
  #ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(aes(color = COUNTRY, shape = factor(YEAR)), size = 2.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("palettesForR::Tango") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Comparison of Crop Area between sum of individual crops and total variable (SE025)",
    x = "Total Area Variable (SE025)",
    y = "Sum of Crop Area (ha)",
    color = "Country",
    shape = "Year"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
#ggplot2::scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_log()) +
#ggplot2::scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_log()) +
```

The greastest discrepencies between sum of individual crops and SE025 are mostly related to the vegetable areas:

```{r high_rel_diff}
high_rel_diff <- comp_raw_crop_sum_SE025 |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(rel_diff))) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 15)
#high_rel_diff |> view()

high_rel_diff_farms <- raw_areas_crop |>
  dplyr::filter(
    # remove mushroom, unused land, other land and rented out land
    !grepl("CMUSH|CUNUSEDLND|CLNDOTH|CRENTOUTLND", FADN_code_letter),
    # crops of which and sub-categories are removed
    !FADN_code_letter %in% crops_of_which,
    !FADN_code_letter %in% crops_sub_cat
  ) |>

  dplyr::filter(ID %in% high_rel_diff$ID)
#high_rel_diff_farms |> view()

# plot crops
high_rel_diff_farms |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = FADN_code_letter, y = area_ha) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(aes(fill = COUNTRY)) +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

## Comparison of sum of individual crop areas between raw data and F2F output

Then, I want to estimate the share of arable and grassland removed from the package filter by comparing the sum of areas for each land use from the raw data and the F2F output.

```{r raw_crop_areas_sum_LU}
raw_areas_crop_LU <- raw_areas_crop |>
  # add land use
  dplyr::left_join(
    data_extra$crops |>
      dplyr::select(FADN_code_letter, land_use_type),
    by = 'FADN_code_letter'
  )

raw_areas_crop_sum_LU <- raw_areas_crop_LU |>
  # sum
  dplyr::summarise(
    crop_area_sum_raw = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(dplyr::all_of(id_cols), land_use_type)
  )
```

```{r f2_crop_areas_sum_LU}
f2f_areas_crop_sum_LU <- my_object_GHGE@crop |>
  # sum
  dplyr::summarise(
    crop_area_sum_f2f = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(dplyr::all_of(id_cols), land_use_type)
  )
```

```{r comp_crop_sum_raw_f2f}
# table of comparison
comp_crop_sum_raw_f2f <- raw_areas_crop_sum_LU |>
  dplyr::filter(crop_area_sum_raw > 0) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    f2f_areas_crop_sum_LU,
    by = c(id_cols, 'land_use_type')
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rel_diff = (crop_area_sum_raw - dplyr::coalesce(crop_area_sum_f2f, 0)) /
      crop_area_sum_raw
  )
#comp_raw_crop_sum_SE025 |> reactable::reactable(searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)
print(mean(comp_crop_sum_raw_f2f$rel_diff, na.rm = T))
print(quantile(comp_crop_sum_raw_f2f$rel_diff, na.rm = T))
hist(comp_crop_sum_raw_f2f$rel_diff)

# plot comparison of crop area between raw FADN and F2F output
comp_crop_sum_raw_f2f |>
  dplyr::filter(land_use_type %in% c("arable", "grassland")) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = crop_area_sum_raw, y = crop_area_sum_f2f) +
  #ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(aes(color = COUNTRY, shape = factor(YEAR))) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("palettesForR::Tango") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Comparison of Crop Area between raw FADN and F2F output",
    x = "Sum of Crop Area from raw FADN (ha)",
    y = "Sum of Crop Area from F2F output (ha)",
    color = "Country",
    shape = "Year"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~land_use_type, scales = "free") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
#ggplot2::scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_log()) +
#ggplot2::scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_log()) +
```
